title: Typeless App Config
description: AJV schema for the merged runtime config (defaults + user overrides). additionalProperties:false rejects unknown keys at every level.

dictate.description: Electron accelerator string for the dictate hotkey

plan.description: Electron accelerator string for the plan hotkey

abort.description: Electron accelerator string for the global abort hotkey — no-op when idle

undo.description: Electron accelerator string for the timed undo hotkey (10 s window)

provider.description: AI provider used for speech-to-text transcription

language.description: BCP-47 language tag forwarded to the transcription API (e.g. en, en-US)

silenceThresholdMs.description: Milliseconds of silence before auto-stop while recording

continuousMode.description: Addon: keep recording after first silence (step 61)

maxRecordingSeconds.description: Hard auto-stop guard in seconds regardless of silence detection

trailingMs.description: Extra capture window after key release before SoX is killed, to avoid cutting off the last syllable

minRecordingMs.description: Minimum recording duration in ms — shorter recordings are rejected with EMPTY_TRANSCRIPT shown in HUD

geminiModel.description: Gemini model used for audio transcription

openaiModel.description: OpenAI model used for audio transcription

grokModel.description: Grok model used for audio transcription (OpenAI-compatible)

claudeModel.description: Claude model used for the cleanup pass in claude provider mode

transcriptionTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds before transcription API call times out

plannerProvider.description: AI provider used for plan generation

plannerModel.description: Model identifier for the planner provider

visionProvider.description: AI provider used for screenshot vision analysis

visionEnabled.description: false disables all vision API calls

confirmBeforeExecute.description: Show plan preview and require confirmation before executing

maxSteps.description: Plans exceeding this step count are rejected by validator.js

stepRetries.description: Max retries per failed step before surfacing error to user

maxRequestsPerMinute.description: Hard cap on total API requests per minute — 60 s cooldown if exceeded

maxPlanRequestsPerMinute.description: Shared cap for plan gen + edit re-inference + clarification re-plans

codeMode.description: Enable code-mode system prompt for the planner

codeInsertViaClipboard.description: Insert code results via clipboard paste instead of keyboard.type()

restoreFocusAfter.description: Restore focus to the target window after plan execution completes

showStepProgress.description: Show per-step progress indicator in the HUD during execution

typingSpeed.description: Milliseconds delay between typed characters; 0 = instant

hudPosition.description: HUD overlay anchor position on screen

sensitiveContextApps.description: App names that always block cloud AI calls (sensitive context enforcement)

pillFadeOnIdle.description: Fade the HUD pill to 30% opacity after 5 s of idle

allowedWritePaths.description: Paths the agent is permitted to write files to

allowedReadPaths.description: Paths the agent is permitted to read files from

deniedPaths.description: User-defined extra denied paths — merged with SYSTEM_DENIED_PATHS at runtime

allowedCommands.description: Allowlisted shell commands: [{name, path, allowedArgs?, workingDir?}]

allowDelete.description: Allow plan steps to delete files

allowShellExec.description: Allow plan steps to invoke shell commands via runCommand

allowOverwrite.description: Allow plan steps to overwrite existing files

enabled.description: Enable text-to-speech readback of completed actions

provider.description: TTS engine (say package not installed until step 64 — safe only because tts.enabled defaults false)

enabled.description: Send anonymous usage telemetry to the Typeless team

localLogEnabled.description: Write structured event log to local disk

retentionDays.description: Days to retain local analytics logs before pruning

level.description: Winston log level for the main process

maxFileSizeMb.description: Maximum size of a single log file in megabytes before rotation

maxFiles.description: Number of rotated log files to retain
